The [[Rose Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] received as a reward from the [[quest]] [[Fire and Pain]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]])
:Halves [[casting time]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
[[Rose Focus]] has a unique skin.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[focus core]]s, "of Swiftness" and "of Fortitude".

== Unique counterparts ==

* There are no unique counterparts.

== Notes ==

* This item has [[clipping]] issues when equipped.
* [[The Shadestone]] is an equivalent focus that requires [[Blood Magic]] instead of Fast Casting.
* PvP version cannot be dyed.

== Trivia ==
* This weapon is based upon several design entries, for the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|Design-a-Weapon Contest]] held in 2007.
